scope: Independent read-only frozen C manager and actual native IOKit adapter source review, with host fault/refcount/reentry execution. No actual native allocation, preparation, completion, backing/protection derivation, driver activation or hardware admission.
implementation_clarifications: Before source freeze, root required two-phase control setup, explicit trusted complete protection lists, opaque-lock extent honesty and whole-domain halt on every quarantine. These are documented in README and source receipt; original design/core receipts remain unchanged.

checks.name: Two-phase setup and default not-ready gate
checks.evidence: native_iokit.cpp pin_empty is single-attempt/single-threaded setup; it allocates only empty typed control anchor+IOLock and returns exact anchor identity/generation/CPU extent and opaque lock address. configure requires that exact setup and valid complete/provenance/nonempty bounded CPU+PA lists, checks both page sizes and succeeds once. Before configuration all backing operations return refusal; no descriptor factory call. Invalid pure config leaves zero manager and may be corrected, not a backing retry.

checks.name: Protection checking is bounded and honestly limited
checks.evidence: backing.c validates supplied CPU extents and36-bit protected PA extents then copies lists. Every acquired CPU/PA full-page span is checked against those lists plus intrinsic full anchor CPU range; core separately checks trusted RAM/reservations. Completeness/provenance label is not authenticated or derived here. No guessed IOLock size/PA, pmap/VA-to-PA helper or complete physical control coverage is claimed. Genuine setup remains unready.

checks.name: Independent real strong-reference owner
checks.evidence: NativeAnchor uses12 OSPtr fields, permanent static pointer, placement construction on heap and deleted destructor. Factory result assigns directly to empty anchored field, before any explicit prepare. No stack/facade sole owner; all3 identities must be nonzero/distinct before prepare. Token drop does not release refs. Actual source uses native headers/calls, without production fake fallback.

checks.name: Pinned native allocation and explicit pair semantics
checks.evidence: C++17 shared API macros plus actual return-type static_assert; fixed kernel_task/OutIn/MapperNone/HostPhysicallyContiguous/16KiB/mask0xfffffc000 and PAGE_SIZE+page_size guards. Constructor AutoPrepare is separate; exactly one explicit prepare success owns one additional pair. No private wire count reads or retry/guess after failed prepare. Same actual identity required on subsequent actions.

checks.name: All actual views and core binding precede provider writes
checks.evidence: getPhysicalSegment(0,&span,MapperNone), getBytesNoCopy/length/capacity supply views. Manager requires exact16KiB lengths/span, aligned full CPU/PA intervals,36-bit end, identity and cross-job/role disjointness, control/protected lists, then frozen core bind. No zero on acquisition. zero_private rechecks all views/private history; only INITIALIZED accepts bounded data-role copy. Root/leaf have no arbitrary copy API.

checks.name: Native callbacks outside mutex and operation ownership
checks.evidence: Domain busy and exact sequence/generation/slot/role/action/pending recorded under short lock before invoke. invoke runs outside lock, returned identity matched after reacquisition. All public mutation/acquisition/retirement calls see BUSY during operation; bounded inspect remains usable. Reentry and real blocked-callback concurrent caller tests pass. Nonreturn retains busy; no timeout cancellation/reuse API.

checks.name: Complete-all then metadata retire then independent reset
checks.evidence: retire keeps private lease live and all refs held through reverse data/leaf/root completion, exactly one per owned unbalanced pair. Only every success permits bpl_retire_private; only afterward are cached views cleared and native refs reset. Each returned reset is separately checked before slot reuse. Native reset return is not physical-free/drain attestation. NULL-allocation known refusal balances no nonexistent explicit pair.

checks.name: Uncertainty causes sticky whole-domain halt
checks.evidence: All retain() paths preserve first error, quarantine job and permanently set m->halted. Before core-retire boundary refs+claims remain; after partial reset some refs may already be gone, explicitly not claimed retained. Changed bound view/identity, unknown/stale return, failed prepare/complete/zero/copy/reset, unexpected core history and sequence exhaustion exclude new work across ALL jobs. No failed-call retry, continuation or cleanup escape.

checks.name: Generation, resource and copy bounds
checks.evidence: Frozen generation-checked lease plus manager/token generation; handle and call counters checked before wrap. Fourjobs/12refs,16KiB each, original aperture/permission bounds and cross-job ownership through core. Caller outputs/control aliases checked. Copy offset/length checked by subtraction and source rejected against protected controls/anchor/retained known buffers. Accessible immutable source remains trusted C caller obligation.

checks.name: No activation/DMA/exposed retirement or unload mechanism
checks.evidence: No MMIO, DART/IOMapper registration, DMACommand, firmware/IRQ, hardware publication or physical drain API. MapperNone is source-PA/private allocation only, not DMA bypass. No descriptor/view export, delete, reset-manager or force-release entry. This is standalone component code; keeping its containing module resident is an integration obligation, not an implemented kmod-stop/unload gate.

host_validation.evidence: Existing tests link unchanged lifecycle and actual backing.c; generic fake objects retain actual host refs, ctor baseline and explicit pair counters. Actual native_iokit.cpp is also compiled/executed with explicitly labelled original API-shaped test headers and fake strong-ref destruction. Stand-ins are not genuine XNU execution. Before/after mutation faults, stale/unknown returns, reentry/concurrency and exact completion/ref-reset ordering are exercised.
host_validation.test_isolation: Harness frees/discards fixtures or starts separate processes; no production recovery/free/reset API inferred.
host_validation.logs: Tool-captured full test outcome; no newly retained full runner log claim.

native_API_provenance.genuine_target_build: Parent-owned final exact frozen-source ARM64 SDK/mixed-language link/import/frame review is separate and not rerun here. Host test-SDK compilation is not target ABI proof.

remaining_integration_limits: No actual independently complete protected CPU/PA derivation helper exists. Supplied complete/provenance assertions do not establish that fact; real setup/runtime remains unready.

Canonical platform anchor uniqueness, single-threaded bootstrap configuration and common domain serialization are trusted platform obligations; arbitrary C storage mutation/malicious callbacks are outside boundary.
A genuine component build must exclude test_sdk include paths and separately verify actual native headers/macros, mixed C/C++ link and retained-KPI imports.
Containing module/anchor must remain resident for boot lifetime. Deleted destructor/no unload API is not a kernel module loader enforcement proof.
No native runtime descriptor acquisition/preparation/completion/ref-reset or physical drain has been observed.
No hardware or packet admission, PCIe/chip/firmware/WiFi readiness, or permission to enable shared writers follows.
